summary: Token-cost feature wired end-to-end + daemon restarted (also activated on-disk firstSeen/lastChanged timestamps — /state now returns all three fields). Daemon: added taskTokens(key,session,dedicated) resolving transcript via assignee agent transcript_path, else session transcript (dirname(mainTranscript)+session.jsonl) only when session maps to exactly 1 task; exposed as task.tokens in buildGraph. Frontend: fmtTok() + token shown on Flow node status-row (right-aligned '… tok') and orphan chips; live WIP updates ride the 2s poll + 4s usage cache. Verified node --check OK (daemon+graph), restart clean, /state exposes tokens/firstSeen/lastChanged. HONEST GAP: tokens null on all 50 tasks currently because (a) assignee agents carry no transcript_path — SubagentStart hook registers the transcript under the HARNESS agent id while start_task records a logical assignee name (sub-cloud/main), so they never join; (b) no session is dedicated to a single task, so the fallback doesn't fire; (c) post-restart mainTranscript is unset (workspace re-registered without transcript). Timestamps are live but uniform (firstSeen≈now for all, no backfill) so recency grouping/decay won't differentiate until time passes. REMAINING WORK for real token numbers: correlate each subagent's transcript with its task assignee (claim with harness agent_id, or daemon-side session correlation) — a convention/hook change, not done here.
